dedupe_keys.name: tailte eireann high value dataset cadastral parcels freehold and leasehold

description: Tailte Éireann (Ireland's land registry, valuation and mapping agency) publishes the boundaries of each individual title to land in Ireland, in two layers: freehold ownership boundaries (tenure with the capacity to last forever) and leasehold boundaries (leases of more than 21 years, the only ones that can be registered), released as a European high value dataset. Coverage: the whole Republic of Ireland; last modified on 2026-01-09 according to the portal. Format and access: CSV, GeoJSON, KML, Excel, file geodatabase and GeoPackage downloads plus an ArcGIS REST feature service, without registration from the Tailte Éireann open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the parcels are registration boundaries, not surveyed cadastral boundaries with legal guarantee; no owner attributes were read; the parcel counts were not checked. Simulation uses: parcel geometry for property-level exposure, land-use change and infrastructure-corridor studies, and to join buildings and networks to land units. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
